title: Polling: does anyone else feel disturbed but good in Mall World?
content: I’ve always loved that eerie disturbed feeling when I view back room pictures- or when I was younger, invader Zim or courage the cowardly dog type content. Things that make me feel deeply but can’t describe the feeling. I love it though. It’s so comforting to me. Ever since I was young. Nothing gory or disturbing like that. Just… weird. This is how I feel in Mall World. Can anyone else relate?
